summary: Super-Agent non-blocking router: bounded event wake for queued sessions, queue recovery on startup, concurrency regression coverage; existing 15s tick kept as bounded fallback.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing Web queue server, human-turn queue and chat stream routes. No new execution authority, no durable schema migration; queue rows stay the authority.
components.disposition: QueueServerFallback.poke_session (bounded queue 64, drop-on-full with tick as fallback) plus two deterministic wake hooks (queue_enqueue success, chat_stream run terminal) dispatch one target via _dispatch_session_now, skipping min_age while preserving barriers/liveness/A05 backoff/epoch/scope head-blocking. Startup recovery materialises live pending from the durable queue once per process with scope guards. All reductions recorded in tests/guards/function_size_baseline.json. Router short-run/role candidates remain with the separate model-routing delivery; global priority queue unchanged.

components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Wake is a scheduling hint only: authoritative state remains the durable queue; drop-on-full falls back to the existing 15s tick; errors never imply task completion and no automatic retry is introduced.
components.rollback_route: Protected revert of the wake hooks and recovery materialisation; the 15s tick path is untouched and remains the bounded fallback. No data migration.
